categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Galaxy Magnets Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of bonded NdFeB magnets, hot-pressed NdFeB magnets, and SmCo magnets. These products serve as key components in the rare earth permanent magnet industry, focusing on high-performance magnetic materials used in automotive motors, energy-efficient appliances, industrial automation, and information electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including bonded NdFeB magnet production, hot extrusion and hot deformation for hot-pressed NdFeB magnets, and powder metallurgy for SmCo magnets. It has proprietary technologies in mixing, molding, dust-free composite coatings, injection molding, magnetization, and automated production equipment, supported by 57 patents including 14 invention patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include globally recognized brands and leading domestic motor manufacturers, serving industries such as automotive (especially micro motors for mid-to-high-end vehicles), energy-saving home appliances, electric tools, robotics, information technology, and factory automation. The company’s magnets are used in motors, sensors, and various electronic devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for over 74% of revenue, and exports constituting about 26%. Its registered and operational headquarters are in Chengdu High-tech Zone, Sichuan Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Galaxy Magnets operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing rare earth permanent magnet components. It procures raw magnetic powders and auxiliary materials from upstream suppliers and sells finished magnet components downstream to motor and electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in bonded NdFeB magnets and expansion into hot-pressed and SmCo magnet technologies. R&D priorities include developing high-performance, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly magnet materials, automation and intelligent manufacturing systems, and new applications such as automotive thermal management and lidar sensors. It plans to expand production capacity and enhance equipment automation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized rare earth permanent magnet products to industrial customers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, tailoring products to specific customer requirements without subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in bonded NdFeB magnets with significant advantages in automotive and hard disk drive magnet applications. Major competitors include Shanghai Sanhuan Magnetic Materials Co., Ltd., Japanese Daido Electronics, Zhejiang Yingluohua Magnetic Industry Co., Ltd., and others in the rare earth magnet sector. It competes on technology, product quality, cost efficiency, and customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 799 million, a slight decrease of 3.04% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 147 million, down 8.58%. Despite market challenges, the company maintains stable operations with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion. It holds total assets exceeding RMB 1.45 billion and cash reserves over RMB 600 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu Galaxy Magnets differentiates itself through its extensive product variety, advanced proprietary technologies, and high-quality manufacturing processes. It offers high-performance magnets with superior energy efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and reliable delivery, supported by strong customer relationships with leading global brands. Its focus on innovation and automation enhances product quality and responsiveness to market demands.
